query: I just got back from walking my dog this morning, he chased a squirrel all the way across the park and even knocked over a kid's bubble blower, I felt so bad I ended up buying the little one a new pack of bubble solution on the way home. The weather is so nice today too, I was thinking about stopping by the community garden later to pick some of the strawberries I planted there last month, they should be ripe by now. Oh right, I actually reached out to you for help with some order issues. I need to cancel two pending orders, #W4836353 and #W7342738, both for the reason that they're no longer needed. Then for delivered order #W4597054, I need to return the items with SKUs 5669664287, 4900990404, 9862136885 and 6777246137, and please refund the amount to my payment method gift_card_3491931.
